position_sizing.conditional_logic: On loss, next trade lot = previous lot * 2 (martingale doubling). On win or after stop, lot resets to initial_lots. Lot size is also capped by broker minimum/maximum and account free margin.

custom_logic_notes: Classic Martin EA: No indicators used for signal generation — uses a simple alternating or random buy/sell entry. Core logic is martingale position sizing: after a losing trade (SL hit), the next trade doubles the lot size. After a winning trade (TP hit), lot size resets to the initial value. The EA checks for existing open positions before entering. SL and TP are symmetric (equal pip distance), making it a pure 50/50 probability with martingale recovery. This strategy is inherently dangerous due to exponential lot growth on consecutive losses.

Key challenge: accurately tracking consecutive losses for lot sizing and ensuring margin checks are modeled.
